```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(petrographer)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)

catalog_path <- fs::path("pkgdown", "assets", "model_catalog.rds")
if (fs::file_exists(catalog_path)) {
  catalog <- readRDS(catalog_path)
} else {
  board <- pg_board_pkgdown()
  catalog <- list(
    models = pg_model_catalog(board),
    datasets = pg_dataset_catalog(board)
  )
}
models <- catalog$models
datasets <- catalog$datasets

render_card <- function(row) {
  badges <- row$badges[[1]]
  badge_tag <- NULL
  if (length(badges)) {
    badge_tag <- div(
      class = "d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3",
      purrr::imap(badges, function(val, nm) {
        bslib::value_box(value = val, title = nm, showcase = NULL, showcase_layout = "left")
      })
    )
  }

  image_tag <- NULL
  if (!is.null(row$image_data) && !is.na(row$image_data) && nzchar(row$image_data)) {
    image_tag <- img(src = row$image_data, class = "img-fluid rounded mb-3")
  }

  buttons <- row$buttons[[1]]
  button_tag <- NULL
  if (length(buttons)) {
    button_tag <- div(
      class = "d-flex flex-wrap gap-2",
      purrr::map(buttons, function(btn) {
        bslib::button_link(
          btn$text %||% "Download",
          href = btn$href %||% "#",
          size = "sm"
        )
      })
    )
  }

  bslib::card(
    bslib::card_header(div(class = "fw-semibold", row$title)),
    bslib::card_body(
      div(class = "text-muted small mb-2", row$subtitle),
      image_tag,
      HTML(row$body),
      badge_tag
    ),
    if (!is.null(button_tag)) bslib::card_footer(button_tag)
  )
}

render_cards <- function(df) {
  if (!nrow(df)) {
    HTML("<p>No entries published yet.</p>")
  } else {
    cards <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) render_card(df[i, ]))
    width <- if (length(cards) >= 3) 1/3 else if (length(cards) == 2) 1/2 else 1
    do.call(bslib::layout_column_wrap, c(list(width = width), cards))
  }
}
```

## Models

```{r models, echo=FALSE}
render_cards(models)
```

## Datasets

```{r datasets, echo=FALSE}
render_cards(datasets)
```
